prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural architectural concept.
Asset type: paired exterior/interior inspiration board for a construction website prototype.
Create ONE premium, photorealistic concept board in a wide 2:1 ratio, with exactly TWO equal square panels SIDE BY SIDE, edge to edge, a perfectly straight vertical divide at the center. LEFT HALF shows the EXTERIOR. RIGHT HALF shows the INTERIOR. They must feel like the same house and design direction. Style: Modern tropical.
Exterior: an elegant two-storey contemporary Philippine family home, clean warm ivory walls, natural stone, rich timber vertical screens, generous shaded balcony, flat low-profile roof, modest lush tropical garden, a realistic city residential lot. Interior: the same home's calm open living and dining room, cream linen seating, light timber joinery, subtle natural stone, large shaded glazing facing the garden, warm textures and filtered daylight. Quietly premium, livable, and climate-aware.
Editorial architecture photography quality, believable proportions and material textures, daytime, natural soft warm light, polished but achievable family-home scale. Exterior framed in a three-quarter view that shows the whole house within the left square panel. Interior eye-level wide-angle, without extreme distortion, framed fully within the right square panel. No borders, labels, typography, watermark, logo, floor plan, people, text, extra panels, collage fragments, lens flare or dramatic cinematic effects. These are new concept references, not photographs of a real company project.
kind: AI concept reference, not a company project
